evidence.quote: Keep fees separate, subject to court approval, and direct any reduction to the class.

We propose a $35 million class fund, distributed automatically to the members Brightline can identify from its records. Brightline would separately pay up to $2.5 million in court-approved fees and expenses;
Brightline can offer a $31 million class fund plus up to $2 million in court-approved fees and expenses, with any unawarded fees going to the class.

summary: Fees were raised by plaintiff-side counsel at the outset and were negotiated alongside class relief before the final class fund was settled. The transcript does not show any explicit tradeoff between fees and class recovery, any plaintiff-side self-dealing, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
